data.title: Mercedes-Benz Places
data.about:
Discover the epitome of upscale urban living at Mercedes Places by Binghatti in Downtown Dubai. This magnificent structure, a brainchild of Binghatti, reaches a height of 341 meters and boasts 65 levels that transform Dubai's skyline. It offers luxurious 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses. The apartments provide awe-inspiring views of the Burj Khalifa, positioning residents at a prime spot to relish the grandeur of Dubai. Each unit's private pool elevates the sense of exclusivity and serene opulence.

Crafted by Binghatti, a brand renowned for groundbreaking designs and supreme quality, Mercedes Places transcends ordinary living, offering an extraordinary lifestyle in the bustling heart of the city. This is more than a residence; it's a testament to lavishness, refinement, and a high-end way of life, set amidst Dubai's most famous landmarks. Step into a world where every aspect is a tribute to unmatched luxury and distinguished living.

characteristics_module.title: First Mercedes-Benz Building in the World
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• First Mercedes-Benz Branded Residence: A groundbreaking luxury development in Downtown Dubai.
  • Architectural Icon: Towering at 341 meters with 65 stories, reshaping Dubai's skyline.
  • Luxurious Homes with Private Pools: Offering exclusive 2, 3, 4 Bedroom residences, each with its own pool.
  • Panoramic Burj Khalifa Views: Located on a prime plot for unmatched views of Dubai's iconic landmark.
  • Prime Downtown Location: In the heart of Dubai's bustling and vibrant center.
  • Innovative Design by Binghatti: Synonymous with excellence, offering an exceptional living experience.
  • Unparalleled Lifestyle: Combining luxury, tranquility, and sophistication against Dubai's iconic landmarks.
  • Ideal Connectivity: Strategically positioned for easy access to key areas, perfect for urban living.
  • Dynamic Downtown Living: In a neighborhood known for its luxury, activities, and world-class amenities.
  • Eco friendly building: Sustainable skin of building has panels to generate electricity

location_tile.title: Elevate Your Lifestyle in the Heart of Downtown Dubai.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Downtown Dubai, renowned as the heart of the city, is an ever-evolving urban destination, and it's here that Mercedes-Benz Places by Binghatti proudly stands. This area is known for its iconic landmarks, including the majestic Burj Khalifa and the sprawling Dubai Mall. Mercedes-Benz Places, nestled in this vibrant neighborhood, epitomizes luxury living amidst high-rise apartments and lavish villas. Its prime location along Sheikh Zayed Road and near Business Bay ensures easy connectivity, making it ideal for both pedestrians and frequent travelers. Downtown Dubai, with its upscale hotels, leisure spots, and extensive shopping centers, offers a dynamic lifestyle, positioning Mercedes-Benz Places as a premier address in the heart of Dubai's liveliness.

  • 3 minutes to City School Holdings International 
  • 5 minutes to Dubai Mall 
  • 7 minutes to Burj Khalifa Park 
  • 15 minutes to Mercato Beach 
  • 20–25 minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB)

seo.metaTitle: Mercedes-Benz Places by Binghatti: Luxury in Dubai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Binghatti Mercedes in Downtown Dubai, offering luxury homes with private pools and stunning Burj Khalifa views.

more_info.answer: Mercedes-Benz Places is a luxury residential development in Downtown Dubai, resulting from a collaboration between Binghatti Developers and the esteemed automotive brand Mercedes-Benz. This partnership aims to merge architectural excellence with automotive innovation.
more_info.question: What is Mercedes-Benz Places, and who are the collaborators behind this project?

more_info.answer: The development is situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, offering residents proximity to iconic landmarks such as the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall.
more_info.question: Where is Mercedes-Benz Places located?

more_info.answer: Mercedes-Benz Places offers a range of luxury residences, including 2 to 5-bedroom apartments and exclusive penthouses, each designed with premium finishes and smart home technologies.
more_info.question: What types of properties are available at Mercedes-Benz Places?

more_info.answer: Unit sizes range from approximately 1,846 to 6,194 square feet. Prices start from AED 8,800,000.
more_info.question: What are the sizes and starting prices of the units?

more_info.answer: The properties at Mercedes-Benz Places are offered on a freehold basis, granting full ownership rights to buyers.
